model.description: The Grav Classic Spoon in Amber is a timeless hand pipe that combines form and function for everyday enjoyment. Crafted from durable borosilicate glass, this sleek amber-colored piece features Grav's signature quality and attention to detail. The ergonomic spoon design fits comfortably in your hand, while the deep bowl provides ample space for your favorite flower. A strategically placed carb hole allows for smooth, controlled airflow and easy clearing. The Classic Spoon's compact size makes it perfect for on-the-go sessions or relaxing at home. Easy to clean and built to last, this hand pipe delivers consistently smooth hits with minimal effort. Whether you're new to smoking or a seasoned enthusiast, the Grav Classic Spoon offers reliable performance in a beautifully simple design that never goes out of style.
